nodes.name: β-FeOOH nanorod coprecipitation
nodes.procedure: An aqueous solution of 1 M Tris·NH2 was mixed with an aqueous solution of 0.5 M FeCl3, followed by stirring for 30 min. The mixture was poured in a tightly capped polypropylene bottle and placed in an oven at 90°C for 48 h, and a suspension of β-FeOOH-nr was obtained. β-FeOOH-nr was collected by vacuum filtration using a membrane filter (pore size: 0.2 μm). The collected gel was redispersed in deionized water, stirred for 30 min, and then filtrated. This washing process was repeated two times. The resultant gel was used for electrochemical tests without drying. On the other hand, a part of the gel was separated and dried in an oven at 80°C, ground on a mortar. The dried powder was used for the characterizations. The iron-based yield of β-FeOOH-nr was 32%.

nodes.source_text: The deposited β-FeOOH nanorods formed bundled network on the surface of the electrode and exhibited high oxygen evolution reaction (OER) activity, where the minimum OER overpotential was 285 mV at 100 mA cm⁻². ... low OER overpotential of 326 mV was observed at t_CP = 30 min and it was slightly decreased to 320 mV at t_CP = 240 min

nodes.description: Shutdown-based accelerated durability test (SD-ADT) with β-FeOOH-nr dispersion present
nodes.source_text: β-FeOOH-nr/Ni showed very low η₁₀₀ value during 4000 cycles... The OER overpotential was the smallest 247 mV at 10 mA cm⁻² and 285 mV at 100 mA cm⁻² at the 2000th cycle... The Fe/Ni molar ratio... increased from 0.014 to 0.053 during the 4000 ADT cycles

nodes.characterization_summary: CHN elemental analysis shows C 0.0 wt%, H 1.6 wt%, N 0.0 wt%; ICP-AES shows Fe 55.1 wt%, Cl 7.7 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The mass percentages of Fe, C, H, N, Cl in the β-FeOOH-nr were 55.1%, 0.0%, 1.6%, 0.0%, and 7.7%, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Diffractions assigned to β-FeOOH (JCPDS 013-0157) with crystallite size 4.8 nm estimated by Scherrer's equation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The diffractions in the XRD pattern of the β-FeOOH-nr were assigned to those of β-FeOOH (JCPDS 013-0157) ... The crystallite size was estimated to be 4.8 nm by Scherrer's equation.

properties.description: Powder X-ray diffraction pattern with intensity peaks matching reference

nodes.characterization_summary: Bands at 418, 679, and 846 cm⁻¹ consistent with β-FeOOH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the FTIR spectrum of β-FeOOH-nr, bands at 418, 679, and 846 cm⁻¹ were observed ... These bands are consistent with those of β-FeOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Fe K-edge XANES shows average oxidation number of Fe 3.0, similar rising edge to Fe₂O₃.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The fitting of the spectrum of β-FeOOH-nr with those of FeO and Fe₂O₃ showed that the average oxidation number of Fe in β-FeOOH-nr was 3.0.

nodes.characterization_summary: Rodlike shape with width 3-6 nm and length 4-200 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The rodlike shape of the β-FeOOH-nr was observed by TEM ... The width was in the range of 3-6 nm and the length was widely distributed from 4 nm to 200 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: FE-SEM shows network of fibrous materials consisting of bundled β-FeOOH-nr nanorods on nickel electrode.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FE-SEM image of β-FeOOH-nr/Ni showed that the surface of the electrode was covered with a network of fibrous materials that consist of bundled β-FeOOH-nr nanorods.
